paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

annotations.annotation: 该折线图展示了不同层隐藏状态的平均值，提供了门控前后 (before/after gate) 以及与基线 (baseline) 的比较。x 轴标记为“层” (Layer)，线性刻度范围为 0 到 20，以 5 为间隔标记。y 轴标记为“绝对平均值” (Abs Mean)，线性刻度范围为 0 到 5，以 1 为间隔标记。该图展示了三条线。第一条是蓝色虚线，表示“门控前隐藏状态平均值” (hidden state mean before gate)，从第 0 层开始约为 0.5，并呈现大致稳定的趋势，直到第 15 层左右，显著上升，并在第 24 层达到峰值约 4.8。第二条线是橙色虚线，表示“门控后隐藏状态平均值” (hidden state mean after gate)，从第 0 层开始约为 0.05，并在各层之间保持相当恒定，最终略低于 0.1。第一条和第二条线都是虚线，但第一条虚线中，每一个短线（“点”）比第二条虚线中的短线稍微长一些。第三条线是一条实心绿线，表示“基线的隐藏状态平均值” (hidden state mean of baseline)，从第 0 层略高于 0 处开始，并始终保持几乎平坦的轨迹，在 x 轴末端接近 0.04。

The plot illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different layers, providing a comparison before and after a gate, as well as against a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 25 with tick labels marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5 with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines depicted in the plot. The blue dashed line, which represents the "hidden state mean before gate," starts with abosulte mean value close to 0 at layer 0 and exhibits a generally steady trend until around layer 17, where it climbs significantly, peaking at about 4.3 by layer 23. Both the solid green line and the dotted orange line, representing "hidden state mean of baseline" and "hidden state mean after gate" respectively, remain relatively constant at 0 accross all layers.

Die Figur ist ein Linienchart, das die Mittelwerte der versteckten Zustände über verschiedene Schichten hinweg veranschaulicht. Die horizontale Achse ist mit "Layer" beschriftet und reicht von 0 bis 20 in 5er-Schritten. Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Abs Mean" beschriftet und reicht von 0 bis 4 in 1er-Schritten. Das Diagramm enthält drei Linien. Die erste Linie ist eine blaue gestrichelte Linie, die bei etwas 0,5 in Schicht 0 beginnt, einen gleichmäßigen, leicht steigenden Trend bis 1 in Schicht 20 aufweist und dann stark zu 4 in Schicht 25 ansteigt. Die zweite Linie ist eine orange, gestrichelte Linie, die bei etwas 0,05 in Schicht 0 beginnt,über die Schichten hinweg ziemlich konstant bleibt und knapp unter 0,1 endet. Die dritte Linie ist eine durchgezogene grüne Linie die einen ähnlichen Verlauf wie die orangene gestrichelte Linie hat. In der linken oberen Ecke befindet sich eine Legende, die die blaue gestrichelte Linie als "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", die orangene gestrichelte Linie als "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05" und die durchgezogene grüne Linie als "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04" bezeichnet.

Фигурата е линейна диаграма, илюстрираща средните стойности на скритите състояния в различните слоеве. Хоризонталната ос е обозначена като „Слой“ и варира от 0 до 20 с стъпки от 5. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като „Абсолютна средна стойност“ и варира от 0 до 4 с стъпки от 1. Диаграмата съдържа три линии. Първата линия е синя пунктирана линия, която започва от около 0,5 в слой 0, има плавна, леко нарастваща тенденция до 1 в слой 20 и след това рязко се покачва до 4 в слой 25. Втората линия е оранжева пунктирана линия, която започва от около 0,05 в слой 0, остава сравнително постоянна в различните слоеве и завършва малко под 0,1. Третата линия е плътна зелена линия, която има подобен курс на оранжевата пунктирана линия. В горния ляв ъгъл има легенда, която обозначава синята пунктирана линия като „средна стойност за скрито състояние преди гейта, средно 0,71“, оранжевата пунктирана линия като „средна стойност за скрито състояние след гейта, средно 0,05“ и плътната зелена линия като „средна стойност за скрито състояние на изходното ниво, средно 0,04“.

The line plot illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different layers, providing a comparison before and after a gate, as well as against a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels are marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines depicted in the plot. The first is a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", which starts with Abs Mean approximately 0.01 in layer 0 and exhibits a generally steady increasing trend until around layer 17, where it climbs significantly, peaking at about 4.7 in layer 24. The second line is an orange dotted line representing the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05", which starts with Abs Mean 0 at layer 0 and remains fairly constant across the layers, ending slightly below 0.1 in layer 24. The third line is a solid green line for the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04" beginning with Abs Mean around 0 at layer 0 and maintaining a nearly flat trajectory throughout, concluding near 0.04 in layer 24. The blue dashed line doesn't intersect with the other two lines, whereas the orange dotted line and green line intersect multiple times. A legend is located top left of the plot describing lines and their representation.
